audience.programmeDescription: Theology at Tilburg University studies Christian faith and religious traditions through biblical studies, church history, philosophy, systematic and practical theology, spirituality and social sciences. The selected English full-time pathway includes source languages, a mobility window and a Theology thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers genuine connections through philosophy, myth, religious art and heritage, ethics and social inquiry. These courses do not together provide sufficiently sustained theological study of faith, religious sources and practice for a meaningful programme comparison. The verified Tilburg curriculum is shown without a proposed UCR alternative.

curriculum.limitation: The September 2026 cohort follows a 180-EC sequence through 2028–2029, including 30 EC of approved mobility/minor choice and a required 9-EC Theology thesis. Rotating courses are counted once. Research and academic skills are embedded in course credits. Dutch delivery in Utrecht and part-time study are also available.

componentNotes.y3-mobility: 30 EC of approved exchange, Theology electives, an eligible canonical-degree package or another minor. No subject choice is assumed.
